slug: 2026-03-03 Nigeria's Disharmonised Digital System Leaving Low-Income Farmers Behind

facts.fact: NIRSAL's farmer registration for subsidised inputs and loans required entering the National Identity Number, and the system failed to verify a rice farmer in Adamawa State (2024); a GEEP farmer likewise got a 'verification failed' message (reporter's account).

The Federal Ministry of Agriculture launched a National Digital Farmers Registry in 2025, said by the minister to be anchored and accessed through the NIN; the ministry has since noted duplications and inconsistencies in the records.
